title: 第一章 回去泡澡第二章 与生俱来
content_zh:
姜村，一个藏在莽莽群山之中，只有百来口人的小村落。
此时此刻，圆月高悬，万籁俱静，似乎天地都陷入了沉睡，然而在姜村中，却是有着十来个年龄不等的孩子正盘膝而坐，五心向天，面朝圆月，呼吸绵远悠长，隐约可见或浓或淡的雾气环绕在他们的身体。
在这群孩子的前方，有着一个身穿兽皮，体型魁梧的男子正沉声说道：“对于我们来说，月华是极为宝贵的修行之物，尤其今天又是十五，子时更是月华最盛之时，所以不要浪费时间，尽量多的吸收月华，打通经脉，提升你们的实力。”
男子的话没有得到任何的回应，因为所有的孩子都正在专心致志的吸收着月华。
然而，在距离他们大概数十丈之外，却还有着一个十五六岁的少年，孤零零的坐在那里，面前摆满了至少上百种形态不一的草木兽骨。
月光照耀之下，能够清楚的看见这个少年相貌清秀，乌黑的长发编成了几根辫子散落在肩头，身材匀称，同样穿着一件兽皮，而裸露在外的皮肤之上有着不少长短不一的伤痕。
少年那一双清澈的眼睛，虽然大部分的时间都是盯着面前的这些草木，但却会时不时的抬头，看一眼远处那群盘坐的孩子，而每当这个时候，他那稍显稚嫩的脸上总会露出一丝羡慕之色。
少年名叫姜云，对于眼前这样的场景，他已经是见怪不怪了，他知道，自己的这群玩伴正在吸收月华修炼。
修炼，修的是己身，修的是——道！
虽然自己也非常渴望能够加入到他们当中，能够和他们一起修炼，但是爷爷却是从小就告诉自己，因为自己的体质和他们不同，所以不能修炼。
对于这一点，起初姜云是不相信的，直至他私下里问过几个玩伴，并且按照他们教的方法偷偷修炼过几次，发现自己的身体真的无法吸收他们口中所谓的日精月华之后，才无奈放弃。
“不过好在能成为一名药师，炼制出适合他们的丹药，帮助增强他们的实力，至少也是不错的。”
姜云心中安慰着自己，继续将注意力集中到了眼前这些草木兽骨之上。
“云娃子，这是最后一批了吧？记得怎么样了？”
就在这时，魁梧男子走到了姜云的身边，双手背负在身后，饶有兴趣的打量着那些草木兽骨。
姜云抬起头来，笑着道：“是的，穆叔，基本都记住了。”
“好！”姜穆点了点头，丝毫不怀疑姜云的话，那张粗犷的脸上露出了赞许之色。
或许姜云对于自己能够记住这些草木兽骨的特性，并不觉得有什么了不起的地方，但是作为成年人的姜穆可是心知肚明。
炼药需要材料，而最基本的材料就是各种动植物，要想成为一名合格的药师，就必须尽可能多的去了解掌握它们的特性。
姜村所在的这片群山，称之为十万莽山，几乎与世隔绝，其内生长的各种动植物不下数万种，要熟知了解每一种植物和动物的特性，难度极大，过程更是极为枯燥。

而姜云不过是个才十六岁的孩子，在短短十几年的时间里，竟然就已经做到了，这不但需要天赋，更需要坚韧的心性和持之以恒的态度。
“不错！”姜穆忍不住再次夸奖了一句道：“云娃子，日后你肯定会成为一名了不起的大药师！”
对于姜穆的夸奖，姜云并没有表现出丝毫的激动，只是淡淡的一笑，那老成的样子，和他的年龄实在是有点不相符合。
姜穆岂能不知道姜云的想法，比起成为一名药师，他更愿意去修炼，成为一名修士。
伸出蒲扇大的手掌，姜穆用力的揉了揉姜云的脑袋，有心想要再说些什么，但是话到嘴边还是咽了回去。
转过身去，姜穆的心中叹了口气道：“云娃子，不是我们不教你修炼之法，而是因为，你不是我姜族的孩子啊！”
是的，姜云并非姜村之人，而是老村长姜万里，也就是姜云口中的爷爷当年捡到的一个弃儿。
这也不是什么秘密，连姜云自己都早已知晓。
尽管姜云并非姜村之人，但是在姜村，却没有人将他当成外人，十六年的共同生活，在他们的眼中，姜云就是他们姜村的人。
过了片刻之后，姜穆抬头看了眼天上的圆月，大吼一声道：“好了，小崽子们，子时已过，修炼结束！”

“呼啦”一声，那一群盘坐的孩子顿时全都跳了起来。
虽然他们都知道修炼的重要性，但毕竟还是孩子，让他们老老实实的坐上几个时辰，实在是种莫大的煎熬。
刹那之间，就有一道身影快如狸猫一般，冲到了姜云的身边。
“云哥哥，明天你是不是又要出去了，回来的时候，给我抓只三色雀吧？”
这是一个小女孩，八九岁的模样，眉心之中有着三颗豆大的彩色印记，呈三角形排列，粉雕玉琢的小脸之上充满了期待之色。
她叫姜月柔，是姜万里真正的孙女，只可惜出生不久，父母入山打猎时就双双惨遭意外，葬生兽口，留下她和爷爷相依为命，也可算是姜云一手将其带大，故而跟姜云最为亲近。
莽山之中危险重重，所有孩子未满十八岁前是不准离开村落的，但是姜云不同。
为了更好的了解动植物的特性，他每次月圆之后的第二天，都会跟着爷爷进入莽山的深处，一待就是大半个月，而回来的时候，都会给村里的孩子们带点小玩意，小动物，故而村里的孩子想要点什么，都会来求姜云。
“好！”姜云伸出手来，宠溺的捏了捏姜月柔的小脸蛋道：“等我回来，一定给你抓只三色雀。”

“云娃子，回来泡澡！”
就在这时，一个苍老的声音远远传来，而紧接着姜穆也是瞪起眼睛冲着那些孩子们大吼道：“好了好了，小崽子，赶紧去睡觉，云娃子，月柔给我，你去泡澡吧！”
所有的孩子顿时一哄而散，而姜云也站起身来，捏了捏月柔的脸蛋，对着姜穆打了个招呼之后，这才转身走向了村庄深处的一座小屋。
content_en:
Jiangcun is a small village with only about a hundred people hidden in the vast mountains.
At this moment, the full moon is high in the sky and everything is quiet. It seems that the world has fallen into a deep sleep. However, in Jiang Village, there are about a dozen children of different ages sitting cross-legged, with their five hearts pointing to the sky, facing the full moon, breathing long and long, and thick or light mist can be vaguely seen surrounding their bodies.
In front of the group of children, there was a burly man wearing animal skins who was saying in a deep voice: "For us, the moonlight is an extremely precious spiritual object, especially today is the fifteenth day, and the moonlight is at its peak, so don't waste time, absorb as much moonlight as possible, open up the meridians, and improve your strength."
The man's words did not receive any response, because all the children were absorbed in absorbing the moonlight.
However, about dozens of feet away from them, there was a boy of fifteen or sixteen years old, sitting there alone, with at least hundreds of plant and animal bones of different shapes in front of him.
Under the moonlight, you can clearly see that this young man has a delicate appearance, with long black hair braided into several braids and scattered on his shoulders. He has a well-proportioned figure. He is also wearing an animal skin, and there are many scars of different lengths on the exposed skin.
The young man's clear eyes, although he spent most of his time staring at the vegetation in front of him, would raise his head from time to time and glance at the group of children sitting cross-legged in the distance. At this time, there would always be a hint of envy on his slightly immature face.
The young man's name was Jiang Yun. He was already used to the scene in front of him. He knew that his playmates were absorbing Yuehua for training.
Cultivation, what you cultivate is your body, what you cultivate is the Tao!
Although he was very eager to join them and practice with them, his grandfather told himself since he was a child that because his physique was different from theirs, he could not practice.
Jiang Yun didn't believe this at first. It wasn't until he asked a few playmates in private and secretly practiced several times according to the methods they taught, and found that his body really couldn't absorb the so-called sun essence and moonlight that they said, that he had no choice but to give up.
"But fortunately, I can become a pharmacist and refine elixirs suitable for them to help enhance their strength. It is at least good."
Jiang Yun comforted himself in his heart and continued to focus on the vegetation and animal bones in front of him.
"Yunwazi, this is the last batch, right? How do you remember it?"
At this moment, the burly man walked up to Jiang Yun, with his hands behind his back, looking at the plant and animal bones with interest.
Jiang Yun raised his head and said with a smile: "Yes, Uncle Mu, I have basically remembered everything."
"Okay!" Jiang Mu nodded, not doubting Jiang Yun's words at all, with a look of approval on his rough face.
Perhaps Jiang Yun didn't find it remarkable that he could remember the characteristics of these plant and animal bones, but as an adult, Jiang Mu knew it all.
Refining medicine requires materials, and the most basic materials are various animals and plants. If you want to become a qualified pharmacist, you must understand and master as many of their characteristics as possible.
The mountains where Jiang Village is located are called Shiwanmang Mountains, which are almost isolated from the rest of the world. There are no less than tens of thousands of species of animals and plants growing in them. It is extremely difficult to know the characteristics of each plant and animal, and the process is extremely boring.
And Jiang Yun is just a sixteen-year-old child, but he has already achieved it in just a dozen years. This requires not only talent, but also a tough mind and perseverance.
"Not bad!" Jiang Mu couldn't help but praise again: "Yunwazi, you will definitely become a great pharmacist in the future!"
Jiang Yun did not show the slightest enthusiasm for Jiang Mu's praise.He moved, just smiled faintly, and his mature look was really inconsistent with his age.
How could Jiang Mu not know Jiang Yun's thoughts? He would rather practice and become a monk than become a pharmacist.
Stretching out his hand as big as a cattail leaf, Jiang Mu rubbed Jiang Yun's head vigorously, intending to say something more, but he still swallowed the words when they reached his lips.
Turning around, Jiang Mu sighed in his heart and said, "Yunwazi, it's not that we don't teach you how to practice, it's because you are not a child of my Jiang clan!"
Yes, Jiang Yun is not from Jiang Village, but the old village chief Jiang Wanli, who is an abandoned child that Jiang Yun's grandfather picked up back then.
This is not a secret, even Jiang Yun himself has known it for a long time.
Although Jiang Yun was not from Jiang Village, no one in Jiang Village regarded him as an outsider. After sixteen years of living together, in their eyes, Jiang Yun was from their Jiang Village.
After a while, Jiang Mu looked up at the full moon in the sky and shouted: "Okay, little bastards, the time has passed and practice is over!"

With a "hoo!", the group of children sitting cross-legged all jumped up.
Although they all know the importance of cultivation, they are still children after all, and it is really a great torture for them to sit there for several hours.
In an instant, a figure rushed to Jiang Yun's side as fast as a civet cat.
"Brother Yun, are you going out again tomorrow? When you come back, will you catch a tricolor bird for me?"
This is a little girl, about eight or nine years old. There are three bean-sized colorful marks between her eyebrows, arranged in a triangle. Her pink and jade-carved little face is full of expectation.
Her name was Jiang Yuerou, and she was Jiang Wanli's true granddaughter. Unfortunately, not long after she was born, her parents were killed in an accident while hunting in the mountains, leaving her and her grandfather to depend on each other. Jiang Yun could be said to have raised her single-handedly, so she was the closest to Jiang Yun.
There are many dangers in Mangshan, and no children are allowed to leave the village before they are eighteen years old, but Jiang Yun is different.
In order to better understand the characteristics of animals and plants, he would follow his grandfather into the depths of Mang Mountain every day after the full moon, and stay there for more than half a month. When he came back, he would bring some gadgets and small animals to the children in the village. Therefore, the children in the village would come to ask Jiang Yun for anything they wanted.
"Okay!" Jiang Yun stretched out his hand, pinched Jiang Yuerou's little face lovingly and said, "When I come back, I will catch a tricolor bird for you."
"Yunwazi, come back and take a bath!"
At this moment, an old voice came from afar, and then Jiang Mu opened his eyes and shouted at the children: "Okay, okay, little bastard, go to bed quickly, Yunwazi, Yuerou, give me, you go take a bath!"
All the children immediately dispersed, and Jiang Yun also stood up, pinched Yuerou's cheek, said hello to Jiang Mu, and then turned and walked towards a small house deep in the village.
